natural_body: SMB 40% discounts lifted acquisition and near-term revenue but cut retention 12%.

first.rationale: I intend to test a focused onboarding simplification because completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence supports gains from shortening onboarding and reducing signup friction. I would avoid promotional pricing because the prior SMB discount increased near-term revenue but reduced retention. The test should be guarded with downstream qualified-revenue and retention checks, since improved activation may not automatically translate into sustainable revenue.
